deathSays.line: ◈ CRISIS — THE FIRST GRAVE. Ivy is dead. The village digs its first grave, and everyone understands at once: this place can kill you. It just did.
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
Liam is gone — the moot doesn't try the dead. The case dies with the accused; the fire remembers the rest.
📓 Codex: Case against Liam closed: the accused is dead.

What Roman kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
💀 Liam died while you were gone — a wound that wouldn't close.

tableLines.line: ⛓️ Emberhold doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A person, maybe 40s speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
👁 It is not afraid of you. It has exactly one argument and it wins every argument. Trap it at dusk holding a tarp low — or just don't.
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)

Jayden leans in. "That thing — a kite with no string, holding station over the trees. We're naming it. So far: "The Loud Beast" (Jayden); "Big-Eyes" (Carolina); "Loud-Eyes" (Clarence); "Ugly-Eyes" (Odd). What's your vote?"

With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
Emma lets out a breath they were holding. "It's over. It's really over."
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
The woods go silent — not quiet. Silent. Like the world holding its breath. The pack is already moving. They go quiet before the rush. If the birds stop, they're already moving.

📓 Codex: Ashford split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.

💛 You hold Daughter's Drawing. Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
The woods go silent — not quiet. Silent. Like the world holding its breath. The pack is already moving. They go quiet before the rush. If the birds stop, they're already moving.
🧳 Ashford has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🧳 Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Emberhold. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
